title: Simultaneous K-flat normalization of strict quotient expressions
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with uniformizer $\varpi$, and composable scheme morphisms $Z\xrightarrow hX\xrightarrow fY$ on which $\ell$ is invertible [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. For $W=Z,X,Y$ set $B_{W,n}=(\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n)_W$ on the small pro-etale site, $R_W=\varprojlim_nB_{W,n}$, and write $q^W_{m,n}:B_{W,m}\to B_{W,n}$ for the quotient maps, for $m\geq n\geq1$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Let $P_1,\ldots,P_r$ be any finite list, possibly empty, of integer-indexed K-flat complexes of $R_Y$-module sheaves with flat terms [def-pc-kflat-complex, def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules].

A finite expression here starts with the complexes $P_{i,n}=P_i\otimes_{R_Y}B_{Y,n}$ at $Y$ and the units $B_{W,n}[0]$ at each $W$, and applies finitely many direct-sum total tensors of two expressions on the same scheme [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] and termwise module pullbacks along $f,h,f\circ h$ [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Denote its resulting complex at $W$ by $K_n$. Give the generators their actual quotient transitions, and give tensor and pullback expressions the induced semilinear transitions $t^K_{m,n}:K_m\to\operatorname{Res}_{m,n}K_n$; scalar restriction is along $q^W_{m,n}$ [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars].

Every such $K_n$ is K-flat with flat terms over $B_{W,n}$. Its localization computes the same expression with derived tensor and derived pullback [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings, lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. The $t^K_{m,n}$ obey the identity and quotient cocycle strictly, so after restriction to $R_W$ they define a complex of strict towers. Their derived transition-adjoints
$$\alpha^K_{m,n}:K_m\otimes^L_{B_{W,m}}B_{W,n}\longrightarrow K_n$$
are represented on these very complexes by the ordinary tensor-adjoints of $t^K_{m,n}$ and are isomorphisms. For a generator $P_i$ this representative is
$$(P_i\otimes_{R_Y}B_{Y,m})\otimes_{B_{Y,m}}B_{Y,n}\longrightarrow P_i\otimes_{R_Y}B_{Y,n},\qquad (x\otimes b)\otimes a\longmapsto x\otimes q^Y_{m,n}(b)a,$$
with inverse $x\otimes a\mapsto(x\otimes1)\otimes a$; the unit case is the same multiplication formula. For a tensor expression its adjoint is the strong monoidal scalar-extension comparison followed by $\alpha^U_{m,n}\otimes^L\alpha^V_{m,n}$. For a pullback expression along $g:W'\to W$, its adjoint is $g^{-1}\alpha^U_{m,n}$ under the canonical scalar-change comparison and $g^{-1}B_{W,j}\cong B_{W',j}$ for $j=m,n$. Thus these particular strict expression towers are normalized coherent systems [def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower], with the adjoints of their actual transitions. No boundedness, constructibility or flatness of $q^W_{m,n}$ is assumed.
